info.title: ArthaIQ Compensation Intelligence API
info.description: India Tech Compensation Intelligence Serving Engine (Decision Support v1).

get.description:
Perform operational health check on serving bundle and runtime readiness.

Returns:
- 200 OK: Manager is initialized with an active, smoke-tested model bundle.
- 503 Service Unavailable: No bundle is loaded or manager is unpromoted.
Basic process liveness check indicating FastAPI server is responsive.
Readiness probe indicating whether API is primed to accept estimation traffic.

Expose application metrics in standard Prometheus text exposition format (v0.0.4).

Returns cumulative HTTP traffic counts, latency histograms, estimation outcomes,
and abstention counters partitioned by reason and macro slice.

200.description: Standard Prometheus text format operational telemetry.

post.summary: Compute compensation estimate or statistically defensible abstention
post.description:
Serve point-in-time calibrated compensation intelligence.

Evaluates candidate profile against active champion model bundle with support checks.
Returns:
- Estimate: Full P10, P50, P90 quantile span when statistical support criteria pass.
- Abstained: Structured abstention with reasons and alternative fallback suggestions
  when empirical support is thin or out of bounds (Rule R-UQ-02 / R-ER-04).

200.description: Prediction result (either supported Estimate or structured Abstained).

schema.title: Response Create Estimate V1 Estimates Post

503.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details when no champion model bundle is loaded.

post.summary: Submit anonymous pilot feedback and comprehension validation
post.description:
Ingest anonymous user feedback from pilot cohort sessions.

Enforces:
- Automated server-side PII scrubbing on qualitative feedback comments.
- Zero raw feedback text emitted to logs (Rule R-CD-06).
- Prometheus telemetry tracking on comprehension confirmations.

200.description: Feedback successfully sanitized, instrumented, and acknowledged.

422.description: Validation error (Likert bounds 1-5 violated, comment > 500 chars).

post.description:
Generate monotonic counterfactual compensation frontier.

Simulates experience, promotion, or metro relocation parameter perturbations
under structural monotonicity constraints without emitting lone numbers.

200.description: Counterfactual scenario frontier with explicit uncertainty bounds.

422.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details for invalid scenario parameters.

post.description:
Evaluate trade-off and risk-adjusted positioning between two competing offers.

Compares fixed guaranteed cash, equity, and variable components against candidate
market quantile distribution, calculating net in-hand take-home bounds.

200.description: Risk-adjusted multi-component trade-off analysis and tax bounds.

422.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details for invalid offer structures.

get.description: Retrieve canonical competency nodes with heuristic difficulty rubrics and provenance.

200.description: Canonical competency taxonomy nodes with difficulty rubrics.

post.summary: Evaluate competency gaps against target role
post.description:
Evaluate candidate evidence ledger against target role requirements.

Enforces:
- Rule R-CR-02: Pay evidence and role requirements remain separate objects.
- Rule R-CR-03: Tri-state verification (Unproven, Self-reported, Demonstrated);
  zero arbitrary composite scores or percentages.

Generate deterministic topological learning roadmap budgeted by weekly study hours.

Enforces:
- Prerequisites strictly precede dependent competencies.
- Effort duration emitted as ranges, never single point numbers (Rule R-UQ-01).
- Labeled heuristic (Rule R-CR-05).

post.summary: Estimate transition effort and pacing options
post.description: Calculate cumulative heuristic effort range and dual difficulty profile for transition.

200.description: Aggregate heuristic effort and pacing projection.

post.summary: Resolve target compensation against empirical role cells
post.description:
Resolve target compensation range against empirical cells via decoupled port.

Enforces:
- Rule R-CR-01: Prohibits claims that completing milestones causes pay increases.
- Rule R-CR-14: Honest abstention when out of domain bounds or unsupported.

200.description: Resolution of empirical role cells or honest abstention.

post.summary: Sanitize untrusted job description and extract competencies
post.description:
Sanitize untrusted job description text and deterministically match competencies.

Enforces:
- Rule R-CR-09: Untrusted text isolation (treated strictly as data, never instructions).
- Rule R-CR-12 & ADR-0012: Zero server-side persistence or storage.

200.description: Extracted competencies with zero persistent storage guarantee.
